entries.title: Major oil exporters agree to keep production steady in November

entries.title: Inside the study for a remedy to fight Congo's deadliest Ebola outbreak

entries.title: What to know about the Kelvin wave raising the sea level along the West Coast
entries.snippet: Kelvin waves are not like tsunamis, and they don't curl over and crash on the beach. A better image is water sloshing in the bathtub or a swimming pool during an earthquake. In the ocean, they are bulges of water that lift the sea level as they move along the coast.

entries.title: Tennessee's prison chief resigns after botched execution of murderer Christa Pike

entries.title: Ukraine to step up oil attacks as Russia hits Kyiv bridges

entries.title: Spain: Massive protests after housing bills voted down

entries.title: Greece returns remains of Czar Samuel to Bulgaria
